saveFolderDesc: Awọn faili ti o gba yoo wa ni ipamọ sinu fọlẹti yii. O le yi pada nigbakugba.
deviceNameDesc: Orukọ yii yoo han ninu akojọ profaili ati ibomiiran.
aboutDescription: MAYO Share jẹ ọfẹ, orisun-ìmọ, ohun elo gbigbe faili aisinipo fun Windows. O jẹ ki o fi ati gba awọn faili laisi intanẹẹti, ni lilo Wi-Fi agbegbe tabi hotspot. O jẹ apẹrẹ fun awọn ile-iwe, awọn ọfiisi, ati awọn agbegbe ti o jinna nibiti data jẹ gbowolori tabi ko si.
platformsDetail: Windows (64‑bit) · macOS n bọ laipẹ · Linux n bọ laipẹ
author: Onkọwe
contributionsDetail: Lọwọlọwọ jẹ iṣẹ akanṣe adashe. Awọn ilowosi agbegbe ni a ṣe itẹwọgba nipasẹ GitHub.
translationsDetail: Ti ṣakoso lori Weblate. Ṣe iranlọwọ tumọ si Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, ati diẹ sii!
licenseDetail: Ti gba iwe-aṣẹ labẹ GPLv3. Wo faili LICENSE fun awọn alaye.
startingHotspotFallback: Ko si nẹtiwọki to wa. N bẹrẹ hotspot…
hotspotActiveStartingServer: Hotspot ti ṣiṣẹ. N bẹrẹ olupin igbasilẹ…
shareFilesDesc: Fi awọn faili ranṣẹ si ẹrọ miiran nipasẹ hotspot rẹ
receiveFilesDesc: Gba awọn faili lati ẹrọ miiran lori nẹtiwọki kanna
setupComplete: Iṣeto ti pari! O ti ṣetan lati lo MAYO Share.
adapterNotFound: Adapter ko ri. Jọwọ pada ki o tun awọn igbesẹ ṣe.
step1Instruction: Tẹ bọtini isalẹ. Oluṣeto hardware yoo ṣii laifọwọyi.
step1Note: Nigbati o ba ṣii, tẹ "Next" lati tẹsiwaju.
step2Instruction: Ninu Oluṣeto, yan "Install the hardware that I manually select from a list", lẹhinna tẹ Next.
step2Note: Yipo si isalẹ ki o yan "Network adapters", lẹhinna tẹ Next.
step3Instruction: Ninu akojọ Olupese, yan "Microsoft". Ninu akojọ Awoṣe, yan "Microsoft KM-TEST Loopback Adapter".
step4Instruction: Tẹ bọtini isalẹ lati ṣayẹwo boya adapter ti fi sii daradara.
step4Note: O yẹ ki o ri aami ṣayẹwo alawọ ewe ti ohun gbogbo ba ṣetan.
enjoyingMayoShare: Ṣe o ngbadun MAYO Share? Jẹ ki awọn miiran mọ!
thankYouFeedback: O ṣeun fun awọn esi rẹ!
youRatedMayoShare: O ti ṣe iṣọra MAYO Share {{rating}} irawọ
ratingSubmittedThankYou: Iṣọra ti fi silẹ. O ṣeun!
willSyncRatingWhenOnline: Yoo mu iṣọra ṣiṣẹpọ nigbati o ba wa lori ayelujara.
ratingSavedWillSyncWhenOnline: Iṣọra ti fipamọ. Yoo mu ṣiṣẹpọ nigbati o ba wa lori ayelujara.
joinDeviceConnectDesc: Gba awọn faili lati igba MAYO Share kan. Lẹẹmọ koodu ifunni tabi ṣawari awọn ẹrọ nitosi laifọwọyi.
receiveFromBrowserDesc: Jẹ ki foonu tabi ẹrọ eyikeyi fi awọn faili ranṣẹ SI kọmputa yii. Ko si app ti a beere lori ọwọ wọn.
filesWillBeShared: Awọn faili yoo pin lori nẹtiwọki yii.
hotspotRequired: Ko si nẹtiwọki ti a ri. Hotspot rẹ gbọdọ ṣiṣẹ ṣaaju pinpin awọn faili.
hotspotFailed: Hotspot kuna lati bẹrẹ. Ṣayẹwo log fun awọn alaye.
createOrJoin: Ṣẹda tabi dara pọ mọ iṣẹ kan lati bẹrẹ.
noNetworkDetected: Ko si nẹtiwọki ti a ri. Jọwọ sopọ mọ nẹtiwọki Wi‑Fi tabi bẹrẹ hotspot rẹ ni akọkọ.
connectToWifiHint: Jọwọ sopọ mọ nẹtiwọki Wi‑Fi tabi bẹrẹ hotspot rẹ ki o tun gbiyanju.
pasteOfferCode: Lẹẹmọ koodu ifunni lati ẹrọ miiran:
yourAnswerCode: Koodu idahun rẹ — fun eyi pada:
dataChannelOpen: Ti sopọ! Ikanni data ti ṣii.
shareLinkOrQR: Pin ọna asopọ tabi koodu QR — olugba ṣii i ni aṣàwákiri eyikeyi.
addFilesThenStart: Fi awọn faili kun, lẹhinna bẹrẹ pinpin.
tellReceiverToConnect: Sọ fun olugba lati sopọ mọ hotspot rẹ ki o ṣii ọna asopọ yii.
noFilesAdded: Ko si faili ti a fi kun.
addFilesHint: Tẹ "Fi Awọn Faili kun", "Fi Fọlẹti kun", tabi tẹ Ctrl+V lati lẹẹmọ.
howToShare: Bawo ni iwọ yoo ṣe fẹ pin?
quickShareDesc: Pin awọn faili nipasẹ ọna asopọ tabi QR koodu. Olugba nikan nilo aṣàwákiri — ko si app ti a beere.
deviceConnectDesc: Ipese P2P ni kikun — ṣe akopọ awọn faili pupọ, fagilee nigbakugba, tun bẹrẹ gbigbe. O nilo MAYO Share lori awọn ẹrọ mejeeji.
supportDescription: Ti o ba diju, tun ṣe itọsọna iṣeto tabi kan si wa.
troubleshootSubtitle: Ṣe iwadii ati ṣatunṣe awọn iṣoro asopọ ti o wọpọ.
firewallAutoFixDesc: Firewall Windows le di awọn asopọ ti nwọle lori awọn ibudo 3000 ati 3001. Tẹ bọtini lati fi ofin ti a beere kun laifọwọyi.
firewallRuleAdded: Ofin Firewall ti fi kun ni aṣeyọri.
runAsAdmin: Jọwọ ṣiṣẹ MAYO Share gẹgẹ bi Alakoso lati yi awọn ofin Firewall pada.
networkPortStatusDesc: Ṣayẹwo agbegbe nẹtiwọki rẹ lọwọlọwọ ati boya awọn ibudo olupin n gbọ.
publicNetworkAdvice: O ti sopọ mọ nẹtiwọki **Public** kan. Diẹ ninu awọn nẹtiwọki n di ibaraẹnisọrọ laarin awọn ẹrọ. Fun asopọ ti o ni idaniloju, gbiyanju lati lo hotspot aisinipo: *Gbigba > Bẹrẹ Hotspot Aisinipo*
activityDescription: Àwọn gbigbe faili rẹ tuntun yoo hàn nibi.
